hypothesis: A phase-observed local cold/fixed warm replay may separate new search work from dispatch/output/controller delays. It cannot retroactively locate the original hosted stall.

case_contract.cold: Derived14command setup/finalFEN/go/isready/stop/stop/quit; fresh process and no prior repetition/search state.
case_contract.warm: All260original Baseline commands,50go requests, byte-for-byte order and historical clocks; wait each actual handshake/ready/bestmove. Force original next positions; record move divergence.
case_contract.runs: One fixed cold-then-warm execution; no repetitions, filtering, engine outcome selection, games, PGN reconstruction, match acceptance or changed original tolerance.

engine_settings: OriginalThreads1/Hash32/MoveOverhead10/OwnBookfalse; actual source/network/clock allocation remain c5 except telemetry observer cost. Strict C++20 Release v3/znver5 non-fast-math/non-LTO/ffp-contractoff.

telemetry_contract.cpu_comparisons: Process CPU deltas only samepid; thread CPU only samepid/tid. Sequential clock samples are not simultaneous.
telemetry_contract.previous_write_metrics: Prior complete event formatting+clock+append costs, not syscall-only. Last event per thread is not carried to later output. Offline summary filters previous IDs to the same search.
telemetry_contract.missing_telemetry: Reject incomplete or duplicate IDs, phase mismatches, dropped/truncated writes, unjoined capture or illegal bestmoves; retain failures.

interpretation_limits: No games, Elo, throughput, native Ryzen/Windows or general clock-reliability inference.
Warm forced board history is retained; timed local execution and instrumentation need not recreate original TT/history/search state.
Outgoing-go to receipt includes scheduling and transport; wall-minus-CPU includes blocking/I/O/scheduling and cannot uniquely identify host preemption.
No local reproduction, including failure to observe a stall, resolves the original hosted cause without corresponding original phase telemetry.

cleanup.result: Two genuine original cleanup assertion failures; same two real-process contracts pass after correction. Cleanup code unchanged by later registry-only fix.

expected_input_registry.result: One genuine original registry assertion failure and passing unchanged control; corrected runner passes both. Capture blocked before any executable can run.
